sources.title: Demystifying evals for AI agents \ Anthropic
sources.snippet: The structure of an evaluation An evaluation ("eval") is a test for an AI system: give an AI an input, then apply grading logic to its output to measure success. In this post, we focus on automated evals that can be run during development without real users. Single-turn evaluations are straightforward: a prompt, a response, and grading logic.
